items.question: What flower made of the great seat is rare for all gods?
premises: The flower is made of the great seat.
It is rare for all gods.
items.inference: The great-seat flower is a rare offering even for all gods.
uncertainties: The exact ritual referent of mahāpīṭha is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: The flower made of the great seat is rare for all gods.
